DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届けの印鑑についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are here about your registered seal, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行用の印鑑をなくしました。引き出す予定はありませんが、紛失の連絡をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届出印紛失と引出予定なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost the seal I use for banking. I do not plan to withdraw money, but I would like to report the loss.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report losing the registered seal and having no planned withdrawal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、なくなったことに気づきましたか。通帳はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did you notice it was missing? Do you have your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日気づきました。通帳は家にあります。印鑑だけ見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日発覚と通帳は家にあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I noticed yesterday. My passbook is at home. Only the seal is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed yesterday and the passbook is at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず紛失のお届けを伺います。ご本人確認の書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, we will take your loss report. Do you have identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 運転免許証を持っています。新しい印鑑へ替える手続きも、後でできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 免許証を示し後日の印鑑変更を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my driver's license. Can I also complete the procedure to change to a new seal later?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present your driver's license and ask about changing the seal later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更の手続きを担当からご案内します。今日は新しい印鑑もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The coordinator will explain the change procedure. Do you have a new seal with you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はありません。紛失の連絡を先にして、変更に必要な物を教えてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新印未所持で紛失届と変更持参物案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not today. I would like to report the loss first and be told what to bring for the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do not have a new seal and request the loss report and guidance on items needed for the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へその用件を伝えます。見つかった場合も、変更前に銀行へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the coordinator your request. If you find it, please notify the bank before the change as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。免許証を出して紛失を届け、変更の持ち物を聞いてから準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認と紛失届を先行し変更準備を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will present my license and report the loss, then ask what to bring for the change before preparing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to verify your identity and report the loss first, then prepare for the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will take you to the coordinator. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらでお会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will check your items out here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持参の買物かごを持っています。会計した品を、このかごへ入れてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計品の持参かご詰めを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought my own shopping basket. Could you put the checked-out items in this basket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for your purchases to be packed in your own basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: サイズを確認します。この台に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the size. Please put it on this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 台に置きました。野菜を下に入れても大丈夫ですが、卵は上にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かごを置き卵を上にする希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have put it down. The vegetables can go at the bottom, but I would like the eggs on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Place the basket and ask for the eggs to go on top. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 卵は最後に載せます。パンも上へ入れましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will put the eggs on last. Shall I put the bread on top too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。パンはつぶしたくないので、卵の横にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パンも上の卵横へ入れるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I do not want the bread crushed, so please put it beside the eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the bread on top beside the eggs too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会計が終わりました。品を持参かごへ移しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Checkout is complete. I have transferred the items to your basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 卵とパンが上にありますね。店のかごは、このレジの横へ返せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配置を確認し店かご返却場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The eggs and bread are on top. Should I return the store basket beside this register?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the arrangement and ask where to return the store basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、そちらに重ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please stack it over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 店のかごを返しました。持参かごの品を確認して、このまま持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 店かごを返し持参かごで持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have returned the store basket. I will check the items in my own basket and take them home as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the store basket and say you will take your purchases home in your own basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お買い上げありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for shopping with us. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 風車の工作を体験されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to try making a pinwheel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。切ってある紙を組み立てる工作でしょうか。はさみを使わずにできる物を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: はさみなしの風車工作内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Is this a craft where we assemble precut paper? I am looking for something I can do without scissors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about making a pinwheel without scissors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙は切ってあります。角を中央へ折り、穴を重ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The paper is already cut. Fold the corners toward the center and align the holes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四つの角を折りました。裏と表で色が違いますが、青い面を外側にしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 四角を折り青面を外へ向ける可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have folded the four corners. The front and back have different colors. Can I have the blue side facing out?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you folded the four corners and ask whether the blue side can face out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 青い面で結構です。重ねた穴へ、こちらの留め具を通します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The blue side is fine. Put this fastener through the aligned holes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 穴を重ねて留め具を通せました。持ち手へ付ける時、紙を強く押し付けるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 留具挿入後の持手との隙間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have aligned the holes and put the fastener through. When attaching it to the handle, do I press the paper tightly against it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After inserting the fastener, ask about the gap between the paper and handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 少し隙間を残します。回れるように、こちらの小さな輪を間へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Leave a small gap. Put this little ring between them so it can spin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 輪を入れました。軽く吹いたら羽根が回ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 輪を挟んで羽根が回ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have inserted the ring. When I blow gently, the blades spin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you inserted the ring and the blades spun. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 完成ですね。持ち手にはお名前を書く場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is finished. There is a space to write your name on the handle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここに名前を書きました。羽根をつぶさないよう、持ち手を握って持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前を入れ羽根保護した持帰りを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written my name here. I will carry it home by the handle so I do not crush the blades.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you wrote your name and will carry it home while protecting the blades. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: きれいにできましたね。ご参加ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27231-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: It turned out nicely. Thank you for taking part.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 到着する駅のご案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions at your arrival station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 病院へ行きます。降りる駅で南口へ出たいので、ホームからの方向を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 病院行き降車駅の南口方向を事前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to the hospital. I want to use the south exit at the station where I get off, so I would like to know the way from the platform beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in advance for the way to the south exit at your hospital destination station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 病院の案内に、出口の名前は載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the hospital's information list the exit name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「南改札から南口」とあります。駅名はこの切符の行先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 病院の出口案内と行先切符を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says “from the south ticket gate to the south exit.” The station is the destination on this ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the hospital's exit instructions and your destination ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その駅では、ホームから階段を上がって左が南改札です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: At that station, go up the stairs from the platform, then the south ticket gate is to the left.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上がって左ですね。列車のどの辺りに乗ると、その階段に近いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左南改札を復唱し階段に近い車両を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Up and left, correct? Which part of the train should I ride in to be close to those stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat that the south ticket gate is left and ask which carriage is near the stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中央付近の車両が近くなります。降りてからも出口表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The carriages near the middle are closer. Please also check the exit signs after getting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 中央に乗ります。南口の外で病院の送迎車を待つ予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中央乗車と病院送迎待合予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ride in the middle. I plan to wait for the hospital shuttle outside the south exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ride in the middle and wait for the hospital shuttle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送迎車の乗り場は、病院の案内と現地の表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Confirm the shuttle boarding point using the hospital's information and the signs there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 病院の案内も持っています。南改札を左へ進み、南口で乗り場を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内持参と南改札経由で現地乗場確認を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the hospital's information too. I will go left toward the south ticket gate and check the boarding point at the south exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have the information and will check the boarding point there via the south ticket gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a class?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の防災講座に行けませんでした。配られた資料を受け取れるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 欠席防災講座の資料残部を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I could not attend yesterday's disaster-preparedness class. I would like to know whether I can get the materials that were distributed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether spare materials remain from the disaster-preparedness class you missed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残部があります。どの資料をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have some left. Which materials would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 非常用品の準備についての資料です。チラシに持ち物一覧があると書いてありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 非常用品一覧の資料を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The materials about preparing emergency supplies. The flyer said there was a checklist of items to have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the emergency-supply checklist materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一覧のある冊子はこちらです。昨日の実演の内容すべては、この冊子には載っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the booklet with the checklist. It does not include everything from yesterday's demonstration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 冊子だけでも役立ちます。家で読みたいので一部ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実演未掲載を了承し冊子一部を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even just the booklet will help. I would like to read it at home, so please give me one copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept that the demonstration is not fully included and request one booklet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。後ろのページには、家族で書ける空欄があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here you are. The pages at the back have blank spaces for families to fill in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 空欄には家の連絡先や集合場所を書くのですね。提出する用紙ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族空欄の用途と提出要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The blanks are for home contact details and a meeting place, correct? Is this a form to submit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what the family blanks are for and whether they need submitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家庭で使うページで、市役所への提出は不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Those pages are for use at home. You do not need to submit them to city hall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で話しながら書きます。一覧と家族用の空欄がある冊子を、一部受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家庭で書く用途を理解し冊子受領を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will fill them in while discussing at home. I have received one booklet with a checklist and family blanks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show understanding of filling it in at home and acknowledge receiving the booklet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞご活用ください。ご来庁ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make use of it. Thank you for visiting city hall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院の説明書で、分からない所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything in your discharge instructions you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入浴の欄です。「シャワー可」とありますが、湯船にも入ってよい意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: シャワー可の記載と湯船可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bathing section says “showers permitted.” Does that mean I can also soak in the bathtub?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether “showers permitted” includes soaking in the bathtub. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この記載はシャワーのことです。湯船については、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That wording refers to showers. I will ask the person in charge about the bathtub.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: シャワーと湯船は別なのですね。傷の所を覆う必要があるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両者を区別し傷保護の必要を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So showers and the bathtub are different. I would also like to ask whether I need to cover the wound.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two and ask whether wound protection is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 傷の状態を確認します。今の保護材は、いつ交換しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the wound's condition. When was the current dressing changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝、処置の時に替えてもらいました。自分ではまだ外していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝の保護材交換と未除去を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was changed during treatment this morning. I have not removed it myself yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the dressing was changed this morning and has not been removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認できました。今回は湯船は次の診察まで控え、シャワー時の保護はこの説明どおりにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have checked with the person in charge. This time, avoid soaking until your next appointment, and protect the wound during showers as shown in these instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明の図が見えました。シャワーの後に保護材が濡れた場合は、どこへ連絡すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当確認後の図を読み濡れた際の連絡先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see the diagram in the instructions. If the dressing gets wet after a shower, whom should I contact?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the diagram after staff confirmation and ask whom to contact if the dressing gets wet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明書のこの病棟の番号へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please call this ward number in the instructions for advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 湯船は次の診察まで控えます。保護の図と、濡れた時の連絡先を確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察までの湯船制限と保護連絡先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will avoid the bathtub until my next appointment. I have checked the protection diagram and whom to contact if it gets wet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the bathtub restriction until the appointment, protection and contact information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take care and get well soon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の活動についてのご質問ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about local activities, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕方の見回りに参加したいです。交番で参加申込みをするのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕方見回りの申込先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to join the evening patrol. Do I sign up at the police box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to sign up for the evening patrol. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 地域の防犯団体が参加を受け付けています。お住まいの地区を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The local crime-prevention group accepts participants. Please tell me which neighborhood you live in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の西側の地区です。町内の掲示板で募集を見ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 西側地区と掲示板募集を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The area west of the station. I saw the recruitment notice on our neighborhood bulletin board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the west-side area and the recruitment notice on the bulletin board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その掲示の連絡先が団体の窓口です。交番では申込みをお受けしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The contact listed there is the group's contact point. We do not accept applications at the police box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 掲示の番号へ連絡します。初めてでも、担当へ活動内容を聞いてよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 掲示番号利用と初参加の内容照会を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call the number on the notice. Even as a first-time participant, I can ask the coordinator what the activity involves, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm using the posted number and asking about the activity as a first-time participant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。集合場所、時間、持ち物などを団体へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Ask the group about the meeting place, time and what to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は歩いて三十分程度の参加を考えています。その時間で参加できるかも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩三十分参加の希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am considering walking for about thirty minutes. I will also ask whether I can join for that length of time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your preference to participate by walking for thirty minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の希望を伝え、活動の条件を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Explain your preference and check the conditions of the activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 集合場所と持ち物に加えて、三十分の参加希望を伝えます。申込み先が分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 集合場所持物と時間希望を団体へ伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Along with the meeting place and what to bring, I will mention that I would like to join for thirty minutes. Now I know where to apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to tell the group your time preference and ask about the meeting place and items to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、団体の窓口へご相談ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please consult the group. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお受取りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。不在票を持ってきました。窓口で受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票の荷物窓口受取を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I brought the missed-delivery notice. I would like to collect it at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request counter collection of the parcel on your missed-delivery notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不在票と、宛名のご本人を確認できる書類をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show the notice and identification confirming you are the addressee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 不在票はこちらで、本人確認には運転免許証を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不在票と免許証を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the notice, and I will show my driver's license as identification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the missed-delivery notice and driver's license. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しました。保管している荷物を持ってきます。箱は少し大きいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked them. I will fetch the stored parcel. The box is a little large.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自転車で来たので、大きさを見てから持ち帰れるか決めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自転車運搬可否を実寸で判断したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I came by bicycle. Can I decide whether I can take it home after seeing its size?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to judge whether bicycle transport is possible from the actual size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。こちらの箱です。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かごには入らない大きさですね。今日は受け取らず、歩きで台車を持って来直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱の大きさで受取延期と台車再来を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is too large for the basket. I would like to leave it today and return on foot with a handcart.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose to postpone collection because of the box size and return with a handcart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。保管期限は不在票のこの日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. This date on the notice is the storage deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期限はまだ三日あります。明日、台車と不在票、免許証を持って来直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限確認後の翌日台車と書類持参を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: There are still three days until the deadline. I will return tomorrow with a handcart, the notice and my license.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking the deadline, say you will return tomorrow with a handcart and documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、本日は保管を続けます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will continue to hold it today. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ローンのご相談を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: How can I help with your loan inquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車の購入を考えています。三年と五年で返した場合を、同じ借入額で比較したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車購入の同額借入を三年五年で比較したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am considering buying a car. I would like to compare repaying the same loan amount over three years and five years.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a three-year and five-year comparison for the same car loan amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 毎月の返済に加えて、ボーナス時の返済もお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you considering bonus-time payments in addition to monthly repayments?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ボーナスは年によって違うので、今回は毎月だけの試算を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 賞与が不定のため毎月のみ試算を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My bonus varies by year, so this time I would like estimates with monthly payments only.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose monthly-only estimates because your bonus is irregular. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望の借入額を教えてください。商品や審査については担当がご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me your desired loan amount. The coordinator will explain the product and screening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 百万円です。まだ申込みではなく、返済額を見て予算を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 百万円と申込前の予算検討を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: One million yen. I am not applying yet; I would like to look at the repayments and consider my budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify one million yen and budget planning before an application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 百万円、毎月返済で、期間を三年と五年に分けて担当が試算します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The coordinator will estimate one million yen with monthly payments over three and five years.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 月々の金額だけでなく、利息を含めて全部で払う額も二つ並べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 各期間の月額と利息込み総額を並べてと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please show not only the monthly amounts but also the total amounts paid, including interest, side by side for both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the monthly amount and interest-inclusive total for each term side by side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。試算に使った金利などの条件も記載します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will also state conditions such as the interest rate used in the estimates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 条件の記載も見ます。三年と五年の月額と総額を比べてから、申込みを考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試算条件と両期間の月額総額を比較後に申込判断すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the conditions too. I will consider applying after comparing the monthly and total amounts over three and five years.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide about applying after comparing estimate conditions and monthly and total amounts for both terms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、試算を担当へ依頼します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will request the estimates from the coordinator. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 香辛料をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カレーを作ります。辛い物が苦手なので、甘口の粉を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 辛さが苦手と甘口カレー粉を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am making curry. I am not good with spicy food, so I would like a mild curry powder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you dislike strong heat and want mild curry powder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品には甘口と中辛があります。袋の上に表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product comes in mild and medium-hot. It is marked at the top of the packet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 黄色い袋が甘口ですね。同じ袋に「四皿分」とありますが、二人分だけ作れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 甘口四皿表示と二人分使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The yellow packet is mild, correct? It also says “four servings.” Can I make just two servings?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the mild four-serving label and ask about using it for two people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う粉の量を半分にできます。開封後の保存方法も裏にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use half the powder. The storage instructions after opening are also on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人分の量を量って使います。残りは袋の口を閉じ、表示の方法で保存するのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 半量計量と残粉保存を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will measure out the amount for two. I should close the packet and store the rest according to the label, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show understanding of measuring half and storing the remaining powder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。今回は粉ですが、固形のルーも隣にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. This is powder, but solid curry roux is beside it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は粉にします。家に玉ねぎと肉があるので、甘口の粉だけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 粉を選び既存材料があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use powder today. I have onions and meat at home, so I will buy only the mild powder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose powder and mention that you already have the other ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの袋でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is this the packet you would like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 甘口、四皿分の表示が合っています。この一袋を買い、半分で二人分を作ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 甘口四皿袋を買い半量調理を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The mild and four-serving labels are correct. I will buy this packet and use half for two servings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose to buy the mild four-serving packet and cook with half. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞレジへお持ちください。お買物ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take it to the register. Thank you for shopping with us.
